# Warranty Flow

> Immutable electronics repair receipts and customer-facing repair tracking. Workshops issue tamper-proof receipts; customers follow every repair stage with a unique Track ID.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Create immutable repair receipts (admin) and track repair status by Track ID (customer).
- [Auto repair invoice generator](/invoice-generator): Free tool to build and print/PDF an auto repair invoice with labor and parts line items.
